title: Microplastic Leachates in Farmland: Impact of Acid Rain on DOM Characteristics and Metal Release
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00233H, Paper
Yinghui Xu, Yifan Mao, Xuzhi Li, Mei Li, Ting Guo, Haibo Zhang, Yimin Cai
Microplastics (MPs) in farmland soil may leach dissolved organic matter (DOM) and metal-based additives during rainfall and irrigation processes, potentially impacting agroecosystems. This study investigated the leaching characteristics of MPs...
